verses.1: And he said to Adam, “Stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.”
verses.2: And a spirit entered into me, just as He had spoken to me. It stood on my feet, and I heard what He said to me.
verses.3: And He said to Adam, “I will send you to the children of Israel. You will go to those nations who have rebelled against Me. Their fathers also sinned against Me, even up to this very day.”
verses.4: And these people are hard-hearted and cruel in their hearts. I am sending you to them. And you shall say to them, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah.”
verses.5: And if they listen, and if they stop doing evil, then those who are in Meri’s house will know that there was indeed a prophet among them.
verses.6: And you, son of Adam, do not fear them or their words. They are foolish and wicked people. Do not be afraid of them or their threats. You must sit in their midst, without being frightened by them. Do not listen to them at all. For the house of Meri is full of wickedness.
verses.7: And you said my words to them. But whether they will listen or not, and whether they will stop or not… it’s up to them.
verses.8: And you, son of Adam, listen to what I say. Do not be like a house that is full of noise and chaos. Do not eat what I give you.
verses.9: And I will see, and behold, a hand that is sent to me; and in it is a scroll.
verses.10: And he opened it before me. It was written on both sides. On one side it was written, “Kinnim ve-Hegah.” And on the other side it was written, “Yeh.”
